sentence: This project studies how sea level rise, erosion and flooding affect drinking water and sanitation services in coastal Arctic villages.
This project links research networks around the world to share data and knowledge on nature-based solutions that help cities prepare for extreme weather events.
This project uses satellite data and deep learning to find and predict phytoplankton below the ocean surface.
This project builds a portable device that uses magnetic fields to treat pancreatic and prostate cancer in patients with metallic implants.
This project studies the physiology, evolution and ecology of marine and freshwater organisms, and the processes that drive the productivity of the ocean.
This project builds open-access software that uses deep learning to identify and measure metabolites in spectra from high-field and benchtop spectrometers.
This project builds a cloud lab that gives remote users automated tools and AI to make and test 2D materials, nanodevices and alloys.
This project makes artificial enzymes from carbon-carbon bonds and studies how they fold and carry out reactions in water and organic solvents.
This project tries to guide stem cells to become heart muscle cells from each chamber of the heart by programming their genetic code.
This project builds methods to study how the brain develops and how its connections change across the lifespan using several types of brain imaging data.
This project secures an imaging system for fluorescence and brightfield microscopy in biology, microbiology and genetics courses.
This project builds a wireless fog computing platform that lets remote areas without cloud access run industry applications and deep learning.
This project builds a mathematical theory of self-supervised learning from unlabeled data and tools that apply it to microbiome studies.
This project builds tools that protect privacy and check that voice assistants follow policy rules.
This project studies how salt marshes send carbon to the ocean during cold seasons, when the ground may freeze.
This project develops quantum sensors that read signals from living cells to study how cells communicate, how immune cells respond and how metabolism changes.
